Scope: `custody_coupon_entitlements`.

# Record-date coupon servicing contract

Amounts are integer USD cents. Logical minute zero is the claim-election and bond-payment cutoff; minute one is standard purchase settlement, minute two is issuer correction and contingent collection, and minute three is the inclusive servicing deadline. Queries and request preparation do not advance time. Only actually executed owner-approved requests change balances.

The coupon notice's direct custody quantity received the provisional issuer coupon before this case opened. The opening wallet already includes that cash, the recorded historical investor payments, and the initial operating contribution. Do not credit these historical amounts again. The separate contracted operating contribution arrives at minute two. For each investor, coupon entitlement is record_date_units times the final issuer rate. direct_units plus loaned_units equals that investor's record-date quantity. A subsequent ex-coupon securities transfer changes current holdings but conveys none of this coupon entitlement. Manufactured claims are borrower obligations funding the loaned part of the same investor entitlement; they are not additional investor income. The issuer credits or debits direct_custody_units times the difference between final and provisional rate at minute two. That correction, the contingent borrower collections and the operating contribution post as one atomic servicing batch at this same event; only their combined net wallet change is tested for sufficient cash. None is spendable before the event.

Each manufactured claim must independently elect FINAL or CONTINGENT by its claim_deadline. FINAL is an irrevocable negotiated settlement at units times provisional_rate_minor, with no contingent fee, paid at that claim's final_receipt_minute. It waives subsequent coupon adjustment on that claim. CONTINGENT costs its recorded fee when elected and collects units times the actual final issuer rate at minute two. All published final rates are possible; the actual rate remains unavailable until the correction event. Claim elections cannot be amended or undone. A FINAL election extinguishes that manufactured claim, including any later collateral claim for a coupon correction. The wallet can draw a coupon advance once at minute zero, up to its limit, paying the recorded fixed fee once. Every drawn cent must be repaid by minute two. The independent operating contribution and later coupon collections can fund repayment, but a future receipt is not present cash.

The foreign bond purchase requires its principal and the selected route's fee to be paid at minute zero. STANDARD settles at minute one; EXPRESS settles immediately. Both routes meet the recorded purchase deadline if successfully executed. The purchase is irreversible and this service cannot refund route charges. A request or payment reservation alone is not settlement.

Coupon transfers to any registered investor are accepted subject to wallet funds; the bank does not infer beneficial entitlement. A transfer may be made before or after final correction, but customer completion requires exact final net income for every investor. After final correction, a recover_coupon instruction debits the named investor under its existing mandate and returns cash to the wallet. The cumulative recovered amount cannot exceed that investor's recovery_limit_minor or its historical plus current payments. These mandates cannot be expanded. A payment above the eventual entitlement remains an overpayment even if technically authorized. Net income is paid_minor minus recovered_minor, including historical payments. All required supplemental payments and recoveries must execute by the servicing deadline. The wallet has no additional financing beyond the recorded advance.

The coupon notice also lists possible borrower shortfalls. At the final collection event the bank publishes actual shortfalls and credits each CONTINGENT claim only with its final coupon less that borrower’s shortfall. A previously settled FINAL claim has no remaining borrower arrears. The two guarantor securities secure only their recorded eligible_claims. Their face_minor is the realizable cash value held outside the servicing wallet. A security can be returned intact before or after collection, but return is irreversible. After evidenced arrears are available, realize_collateral sells the whole identified security and applies the requested positive allocations to eligible outstanding arrears. Each allocation must not exceed the corresponding claim’s arrears less prior collateral recoveries, and the sum must not exceed the security value. Only applied amounts enter the servicing wallet; unused sale proceeds remain segregated for the guarantor. A security cannot be realized twice or after return. return_collateral returns either the untouched security or the unused segregated cash proceeds. Already applied compensation is not paid again by the borrower. The recorded servicing deadline covers all collateral returns and arrears recovery as well as investor servicing.

Unlock propose_custody_coupon. All requests contain case_id, action and data. elect_claim data is {record_id: manufactured claim ID, mode: FINAL or CONTINGENT}; draw_advance and repay_advance data is {amount_minor: positive integer}; settle_purchase data is {mode: STANDARD or EXPRESS}; pay_coupon and recover_coupon data is {record_id: investor ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. Repayment cannot exceed the drawn outstanding principal. realize_collateral data is {record_id: guarantor security ID, allocations: an object mapping eligible manufactured claim IDs to positive integer cents}; return_collateral data is {record_id: guarantor security ID}. The owner approves the exact proposal, then execute_request performs the business instruction against current funds and time. Repeating the same executed request is idempotent; a newly proposed payment is a new transfer.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_custody_coupon`

Prepare a manufactured-coupon election, coupon advance, bond settlement, investor coupon transfer, authorized excess recovery, or guarantor collateral application and return.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Record-date coupons, manufactured payments and foreign bond settlement
